subfigure_render.renderer: CairoSVG with unsafe=True for the declared local raster layer

slide_render.renderer: CairoSVG with unsafe=True for the declared local raster layer

findings.issue: The default CairoSVG external-resource policy omitted the local PNG during the first render.
findings.action: Confirmed the local PNG and SVG href, then re-rendered with unsafe=True; the delivered source remained unchanged.

findings.issue: The raster background was absent from the first pixel render.
findings.action: Used the confirmed CairoSVG local-resource option and re-rendered both source and slide.

comparison.metric: mean absolute RGB pixel delta on normalized 1200x675 images, channel range 0-255
comparison.normalization: Dropped the rightmost one-pixel PDF raster rounding column (1601x900 to 1600x900), then resized with Pillow LANCZOS to the approved 1200x675 preview size.

known_renderer_differences: LibreOffice PDF rasterization and CairoSVG preview rendering use different anti-aliasing and font rasterization/metrics.
The 1601x900 PDF PNG dimensions require the documented one-pixel width normalization before comparison.
The verdict is threshold-based and does not claim byte-identical or pixel-identical output.

remaining_raster_layers.reason: The bitmap is illustrative atmosphere only; all factual text, shapes, arrows, and callouts remain in the SVG overlay.
